caption: The drawing features a single ornate earring, depicted centrally on a plain, off-white background with a thin border close to the edge of the paper. The earring is colored in gold and bronze tones, giving it a metallic appearance with highlights and shadows to suggest three-dimensionality. The earring design is elaborate, with a curved hook at the top for insertion into the ear, connected to an intricate central element that includes scroll-like shapes and symmetrical flourishes, ending with a rounded, textured bead at the bottom. The shapes within the earring are accented by gradient shading from light to dark, emphasizing the contours. At the bottom left of the page, text reads "Ear Drop," and at the bottom right, there is a signature and date: "J. Goward Ipss. 1736."
title: Earrings
